title: Tools: reamer and counterbore tool kinds (split from #897)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Split out of #897 (which also covers spot drill, countersink and center drill, P8): the two hole-making kinds that real tool libraries need most now.

**What happens:** `ToolKind` (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs`) has no reamer and no counterbore. Such a tool can only be stored as a `Drill` or `EndMill`, losing what makes it different, or not at all.

**Why now:** converting one user's real tool libraries to `.camtools` (14 libraries, community converter bnegt/Fusitool2Craftool), 2487 reamers and 42 counterbores were skipped because CamCraft has no kind for them - the largest group of unconvertible tools after missing feed/speed data. CamCraft already has the cycle side: reaming (G85) and dwell/boring cycles shipped with #1445.

**What the kinds need (from general machining references - Machinery's Handbook, ISO/DIN reamer and counterbore standards, public tooling catalogs):**
- **Reamer:** diameter, flute length, number of flutes, lead (chamfer) angle and length, overall/shank; its cutting data runs slower than a drill of the same size (per-material rows, #890); a hole op with a reamer uses the reaming cycle and expects a pre-drilled hole (finish allowance).
- **Counterbore:** cutting diameter, pilot diameter (or none) and pilot length, flat bottom, flute length; a hole op cuts to a stated depth with a dwell at the bottom.
- Both: spun outline that the simulation and the reach/gouge checks read (safety floor: effort high), `.camtools` file version bump with old files still loading, MCP `add_tool` / `edit_tool` kinds, catalog entries.

**Clean-room:** specify geometry and behaviour from the public references above. Do not use Fusion's tool-library schema or the converter's Fusion-side code (also GPL-3.0) as a spec - the converter only showed how many tools are missing.

**Done means:** a reamer and a counterbore can be created, saved and reloaded in `.camtools`; a reaming op and a counterbore op generate, simulate and verify clean on a plate fixture with the tool's real outline; old `.camtools` files load unchanged; pinned by tests.
